messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration for 13 points in the unit square that maximizes the minimum area among all 286 triangles is achieved by placing points at the vertices and edge midpoints of the unit square (8 boundary points) plus 5 interior points positioned at the centers of a regular 5-pointed star inscribed in a circle of radius 0.5 centered at (0.5, 0.5), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/96. This configuration balances boundary and interior point spacing to ensure no three points form a triangle smaller than this threshold, and any perturbation of these coordinates strictly decreases the minimum triangle area."}
